d:
Kenji Miyazawa's "Snow Crossing". This is a fairy tale, and in it there's a song called "Hard Snow Kanko".

On page 16, the siblings seems to be sharing a memory of that. I suspect that they're repeating lines or singing the song, but unfortunatly I don't know enough about it. From what I can tell, "Snow Crossing" is only something you can do when the snow freezes hard enough that it's a bit like ice. Then you can walk on top of it. Seems like a bit of a thrill game similar to "walking on thin ice" except much safer (falling into snow versus falling into cold water). They also have a saying that when you're snow crossing you can go places you never could. So there are some nice parallels to the siblings having their thrilling sex adventure, going new places in the car, her wanting to quit her job and start her own business, maybe have a baby together. If you have more depth of knowledge about this feel free to PM me. I'd be happy to adjust the translation. Or, feel free to do your own.
n: [Manga] [Asagi Ryu] Snow Crossing (Toshishita-kun wa Hajimete yo 5) [Digital]
